text:
Omar (AE): Acme ops says they want to sign POC + MSA this week. They've escalated termination and SLA asks. Need quick alignment.
Kira (Legal): what are the exact redlines? can you drop the doc?
Omar (AE): uploaded: https://drive.company/Acme/acme_msa_redlines_final.docx
file-bot: uploaded file sources/docs/Acme/acme_msa_redlines_final.docx
Sam (Solutions): customer asks: 45-day POC, 2 dedicated nodes, POC usage not billed, plus a POC-specific SLA of 99.95%.
Hana (Finance): Net45 preferred. For non-billable POC we need a credit memo line item to zero invoice. RevOps can countersign pilots <= $60k.
Kira (Legal): immediate stance: can accept 45-day POC and a POC addendum for timeboxed SLA credits. 60-day termination is a hard no unless Sales ok with churn risk.
Luis (Engineering): 2 nodes for 45 days is doable. For EU data residency we can pin to eu-west-1 on Dedicated. Monitoring uses Datadog; will add to subprocessors.
Omar (AE): Acme counsel pushing 60 days and SLA change as non-negotiable. They want signature routing to execs only.
Kira (Legal): counterproposal: 45-day termination, POC addendum with 99.95% for POC only and capped credits, OSS indemnity carveout limited to direct damages. I'll draft counter and memo.
Hana (Finance): send SKU list and we will prepare provisional orderform: Items + Trial Credit line = -$X. Also need billing contact and remit address.
Sam (Solutions): I'll attach SOW + POC success criteria to the counter so scope is explicit (helps limit support asks).
Luis (Engineering): confirm: no external data transfers outside EU for pinned workloads. Adding Datadog to subprocessors now.
Kira (Legal): drafting counter now. Will flag anything requiring VP sign-off (e.g. > $60k or special liability clauses). Expect upload in ~2 hours.
Omar (AE): thanks — I'll tell Acme we can do a POC addendum for SLA and that RevOps can countersign pilot <= $60k. Also asking if we can offer a one-time POC credit instead of changing base SLA.
Hana (Finance): one-time credit ok. we'll include it on orderform. RevOps to finalize routing once docs uploaded.
file-bot: uploaded file sources/docs/Acme/acme_msa_counter_for_acme.docx
Kira (Legal): counter uploaded with tracked changes and a short memo. Marked SLA as pilot-limited and termination at 45 days.
Omar (AE): sending to Acme counsel and scheduling a quick sign-off call tomorrow 9am PT.
Sam (Solutions): will join to walk success criteria.
Luis (Engineering): standby for ops checklist if they accept.
Hana (Finance): will prepare provisional invoice and credit memo template after counter is finalized.
Omar (AE): goal: POC addendum signed by EOD Friday so we can provision. will update thread when signed.
